title: Megurine Luka — Happy Anniversary! 2025〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Welcome, everyone, to this special concert celebrating Luka's anniversary!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whoa, there are already so many comments! Looks like everyone can't wait to get started!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Luka feels the same way. She was humming through her set list backstage just now.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hahaha, I'll bet!
The audience is anxious to get started... Why don't we call the star of the day out here already?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Here we go! One, two, three!

rows.Speaker: Len & Miku
rows.Line: Lukaaa!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hello everyone!
Thank you for coming to celebrate my anniversary today!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: All of you joining by livestream, can you hear us okay?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Whoa, the comments are coming in even faster...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It looks like everyone's been waiting in anticipation! I'm very pleased.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You know, I've been just as excited to see you all. Let's all have a great time today!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Ooh, everyone's fired up already! Let's keep that energy up for the first song!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah! First up is...this song!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wow, only one song in and you're already on fire!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Everyone was super into it too! Oh, more comments are coming in! Um...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: This one says, “I was so not expecting that first one! Can't believe you sang that at a concert!”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We know the whole set list, and we were still really excited!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! I was cheering along with the audience! How was it for you, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Hearing everyone's voices certainly made me happy.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Even when we were setting up for the day, you were wondering how the audience would react, weren't you?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I was. My hope for this show was to give everyone a chance to get to know me better.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I've always expressed my feelings in the form of many different songs, and those songs have shown people who I am.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And so today, I'm hoping to sing a range of songs that show all different facets of me.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's why I've chosen this next song. I hope you all enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Thank you all again so much for coming to my special anniversary concert!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Now we've reached the second half of today's show... It's time for a little game titled:

rows.Speaker: Miku & Len
rows.Line: “Look Into Luka's Mind! Set List Predictions♪”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We have to try and predict the next two songs on Luka's set list. Can you guys guess?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: By the way, this game was Luka's idea! Right Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's right.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I'm here today because of so many emotions...
Those that went into each song, and those felt by the people listening to them.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I chose songs that I wanted everyone to hear as my way of expressing gratitude for that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So I hope that they're also songs that everyone wants to hear.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well then, everyone watching in the audience and on the livestream, start predicting!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm, but there will be so many songs that people want to hear... I bet they're having trouble choosing.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Even I can think of a bunch of songs off the top of my head... I can't imagine narrowing them down to two.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey Luka, can you give us a clue?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I suppose I could...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: How about this? I'll tell you what feelings went into the songs.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, thanks! Everyone, listen carefully!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Okay Luka, let's hear it!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The first song is...cheerful if nothing else. It's a song that I'd like to convey my hope to enjoy this concert alongside everyone here.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Enjoying the concert... Okay, got it! Now the second song!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The second is deeper, I suppose. I want it to convey the feeling of empathizing with a troubled person and gently supporting them.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's a lovely sentiment.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Whoa, check it out!
Now that Luka gave us those clues, there are a ton of comments guessing what the songs might be!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You're right. I wonder if they can guess right.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: To find out...we need to hear what songs come next!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. On that note, let's move on!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Everyone, did you guess right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Whether you did or didn't, I hope you're enjoying the show!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And I hope the feelings I put into those songs reach you!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Nice work, Luka!
Everything you wanted to express came through loud and clear.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah! And so this time...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We want you to hear what we have to say.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Everyone...
song00010_off_s

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary, Luka!
As one of the hosts, I got to watch your concert up close.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And it was so cool seeing you leave the audience spellbound with your performance! Let's keep bringing our songs to the world!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehehe. Both the livestream comments and the concert venue were crammed full of Luka love! I was suuuper happy for you♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But don't forget, they don't have as much Luka love as me! Happy anniversary, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary, Luka!
The songs that you put so much emotion into almost had me in tears!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Did I do a good job as a host? I was doing my best to make it an anniversary to remember for you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Len did practice a lot in advance. But still, we weren't expecting that game to have such a profound feeling behind it. You didn't let on during rehearsals.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I also felt so many emotions from your singing. Please keep charming everyone with that voice of yours!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: How was your special anniversary concert? I'm a little worried that I had more fun than you...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: After all, it's your anniversary! I hope that no one enjoyed it as much as you. Once again, happy anniversary!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay guys, let's all say it at once! One, two, three!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Thank you, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I already said it during the show, but...
I'm here today singing all these songs filled with emotions thanks to all the people who listen and feel those emotions.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm overflowing with gratitude for that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm going to keep singing those songs to deliver all those feelings.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So I hope you'll keep supporting me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Of course we will! Forever!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Thank you so much to everyone who watched the show, too. Thanks to you, I've had a marvelous anniversary.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Please come and hear me sing again. Until then!
